body.name: Positive stationary lag-switch regression pair
body.construction: For the fixed binary input \(V=\{1,2,3\}\), \(\mathcal A_i=\{0,1\}\) for every \(i\in V\), \(X=1\), \(Y=3\), \(L=\gamma=1\), \(q=1/5\), and \(r=1/10\), set in model zero \(O_{1,t}=(R_t\wedge O_{2,t-1})\oplus U_t\), \(O_{2,t}=O_{1,t}\oplus N_t\), and \(O_{3,t}=O_{2,t-1}\oplus E_t\); set in model one \(O_{2,t}=(R'_t\wedge O_{1,t-1})\oplus U'_t\), \(O_{1,t}=O_{2,t}\oplus N'_t\), and \(O_{3,t}=O_{2,t-1}\oplus E'_t\), with \(R_t,U_t,R'_t,U'_t\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\), \(N_t,N'_t\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(q)\), and \(E_t,E'_t\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(r)\), mutually independent across named sequences and time. Both models use exactly this same \(\mathcal A\) and hence induce laws on the same \(\Omega_{\mathcal A}\).
